name: recovery-conformance
description: Recovery MIP on-node conformance: session publish through the seam, freshness backstop, reconstruction and wrap round-trip, the signature gate (recovery key plus successor co-signature, no secret in the proof), veto window and cancel, epoch bump, successor control; pre-existing and pending-window grants stay invalid across two recoveries, then successor-issued JubJub and k256 grants spend without modifying devices.
note: Deployed with birth artefacts and a 60 s veto window; the full lifecycle including real window waits ran against the localnet. Grant negatives are client-build refusals against funded on-chain state, not submitted node-admission refusals.
